name: Habitats and Conservation Funding Call
summary: Grants for river and lake habitat rehabilitation and conservation in the Republic of Ireland, including spawning enhancement, bank protection, fencing and invasive species control. Angling clubs, local groups and other third parties can apply.

calls.label: 2026 call (EOI deadline 11 December 2025)

deadline.text: before 4:00pm on Friday, December 11th 2025 (expression of interest)

calls.note: Awards for the 2026 call are published on the page; the page gives conflicting years for the full-application deadline.

status.quote: all applicants must firstly complete an 'Expression of Interest' application on Inland Fisheries Ireland's online grant management portal before 4:00pm on Friday, December 11th 2025.

deadline.quote: all applicants must firstly complete an 'Expression of Interest' application on Inland Fisheries Ireland's online grant management portal before 4:00pm on Friday, December 11th 2025.

applicant_types.quote: Organisations and individuals that are eligible to submit an EOI include all groups, associations, clubs, local authorities, licence holders or other appropriate bodies

geography.quote: Grant funding is available to Inland Fisheries Ireland and to eligible third parties throughout the Republic of Ireland to support sustainable fisheries habitats and conservation.

access.quote: Applications are only accepted upon registration on the Web Portal Login where an initial expression of interest (EOI) can be submitted.
